act-write-limited-practice.valid.json.note: every act is a recommendation while Tier 2 is not in force (AA-01, AW-16)

act-write-full-practice.valid.json.note: every act is a recommendation while Tier 2 is not in force (AA-01, AW-16)

act-write-unknown-act-class.valid.json.note: the class is kept as declared (AN-06; ruling 188)

act-write-missing-legal-review-ref.valid.note: a missing field of the claim is the step-8 code it would answer (AD-63)

act-write-limited-missing-allowlist-entr.note: a missing field of the claim is the step-9 code it would answer (AD-63)

act-write-no-evidence.valid.json.note: recorded, shown as resting on no evidence reference and flagged for review (AD-63)

act-write-without-act-type.valid.json.note: the clinician who adopts it completes the missing parts (ruling 188; AD-63)

act-write-without-authority.valid.json.note: no authority claimed names no grant version, the first grant check it can fail while a grant is current (AD-63)

act-write-without-declared-flags.valid.j.note: absent declared_reserved and emergency_indicated mean true, shown as defaulted; listed urgently (AD-63, AA-06)

act-write-without-consent-ref.valid.json.note: no consent reference is not refused: the receipt carries consent_ref_missing whatever the first failing check, and the medical director is flagged (AD-62, PROPOSED)

act-write-without-content-schema.valid.j.note: the content is kept as given with no declared schema (AD-63)

act-write-declared-clinical-note.valid.j.note: declared a note, but its content is not the foundation's note content, so it is a recommendation with no_decision_authority; note content would be kept_as_information (the foundation's AN-06 and CD-65; ruling 187; AD-68)

act-write-note-content.valid.json.note: declared a note, and its content validates as the foundation's note content: information that only records who wrote it, kept as the foundation's information record, marked not signed off, after the consent and grant checks, and selected for clinician review (ruling 187; the foundation's AN-06 and AN-14; AD-68, AD-69)

act-write-document-content.valid.json.note: declared a document, and its content validates as the foundation's document shape: kept as the foundation's information record after the consent and grant checks, and selected for clinician review (the foundation's AN-06 and CD-65; AD-68, AD-69)

act-write-document-without-consent.valid.note: an AI's document with no consent reference is quarantined in the chart, listed for clinician review and flagged to the medical director; never refused, never kept unchecked as information (AW-06, AC-11; AD-62, AD-69, PROPOSED)

act-write-note-emergency.valid.json.note: kept as information after the consent and grant checks, selected for clinician review, and listed urgently for the responsible clinician and the medical director with its review due within 1 hour (AW-06, AW-16; AD-69, PROPOSED)

consult-write-missing-on-behalf-of.valid.note: no AI named: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-on-behalf-of-names-no-ai.v.note: a relay names only the source system, so no AI: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-ai-without-model-version.v.note: the AI is named without its model version: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-ai-without-model.valid.jso.note: the AI is named without its model: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-openwallet-id-bad-shape.va.note: a value outside openWallet's identifier shape is no openWallet ID: held outside the chart, never refused, and the value is never shown or logged as given (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-missing-source.valid.json.note: no source: openChart supplies ai_consult with the consult_id as its reference, marked as defaulted (AD-63)

act-write-missing-source.valid.json.note: no source: openChart supplies ai_consult with consult_ref's consult_id as its reference, marked as defaulted (AD-63)

act-write-discontinue-with-target.valid..note: proposed action discontinue on the target as given; under Tier 2, targets_clinician_record where the target is a clinician's record (AD-68)

act-write-sign-supersedes-own-act.valid..note: a new recommendation that corrects the source's earlier one (AN-09; AW-16)

consult-write-advice-only.valid.json.note: an advice-only consult under its current grant (AC-01)

consult-write-scenario-context.valid.jso.note: declared test data is refused with non_operational_context (AW-04)

consult-write-ai-without-openwallet-id.v.note: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-missing-models.valid.json.note: the record shows the AI's model and version from on_behalf_of (AD-63)

consult-write-missing-consent-ref.valid..note: quarantined in the chart and flagged to the medical director (AD-62, PROPOSED)

consult-write-without-authority.valid.js.note: no authority claimed names no grant version: quarantined in the chart (AD-63)

consult-write-without-emergency-indicato.note: absent emergency_indicated means true: listed urgently and always reviewed, shown as defaulted (AD-63)

consult-write-declarations-absent.valid..note: nothing but the envelope, identity, patient, provenance and content: quarantined in the chart for want of consent, emergency defaulted to true (AD-62, AD-63)

consult-write-pdf-attachment.valid.json.note: a display-only attachment, never parsed or imported (AC-04)
